content: {"like":["Values immersive, high-quality visual and audio experiences; appreciates realistic action and strong character development; enjoys innovative and edgy storytelling with a blend of sci‑fi and western elements; prefers well‑executed special effects and believable human reactions; seeks engaging, non‑melodramatic narratives with clear moral grounding."],"dislike":["Dislikes technical flaws such as pixelation, menu hang‑ups, and poor DVD production; rejects overly fast or hard‑to‑follow fight choreography; finds abrupt or rushed endings unsatisfying; is critical of disjointed character portrayals and unrealistic attitudes; avoids content with inappropriate sexual suggestiveness or naive moral themes."]}
